# Memory map

<!-- Generated by `plz gen-docs` from maps/*.yaml: edit the YAML, not this file. -->

Every address is one byte. RAM and EEPROM are separate address spaces (see [protocol.md](protocol.md)). Addresses are hexadecimal unless noted.

## Status legend

- **confirmed**: verified by a write/read round trip or by the manufacturer
- **observed**: seen behaving as described on this stove (dump or live session)
- **reported**: taken from a third-party source, not verified on this stove
- **hypothesis**: plausible interpretation of observations, needs a targeted test
- **unknown**: address of interest, meaning not understood
- **refuted**: generic meaning checked and wrong for this stove

## Palazzetti Connection Box (firmware notes, 2020)

Profile `palazzetti-connbox`.

### RAM

| Address | Dec | Name | Unit | Scale | Values | Access | Status | Write certainty | Sources | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0x0D | 13 | Board / model code (selects the address set) |  |  |  | r | reported | unverified | connbox-2020 | Read first by `GET ALLS`. One code is noted as "0xB model" (alternative addresses below). On the Ecofire Lara it is constant 232 (0xE8) over 47 h, consistent with a model code rather than the generic Micronova auger time. |
| 0x21 | 33 | Stove state (target of SET STAT) |  |  |  | rw | reported | unverified | connbox-2020 | Written by `SET STAT`. Constant 5 on the Lara, so the Lara likely uses another model branch. |
| 0x34 | 52 | Power (GET ALLS, model B, companion of 0x97) |  |  |  | r | reported | unverified | connbox-2020 | Same address as the generic Micronova power level. |
| 0x36 | 54 | Target temperature (GET SETP, "0xB model") | °C |  |  | r | reported | unverified | connbox-2020 | The note mentions bit shifts around the read (`srl`/`sra`), so the encoding may not be plain. |
| 0x37 | 55 | Power level (GET ALLS / GET POWR, model A) |  |  |  | r | reported | unverified | connbox-2020 | Noted with 0x64 for one model branch. On the Lara 0x37 behaves like the fumes extractor speed. |
| 0x64 | 100 | Power (GET ALLS, model A, companion of 0x37) |  |  |  | r | reported | unverified | connbox-2020 |  |
| 0x97 | 151 | Power (GET ALLS, model B) |  |  |  | r | reported | unverified | connbox-2020 |  |
| 0xA0 | 160 | Target temperature (GET SETP, other models) | °C |  |  | r | reported | unverified | connbox-2020 |  |

| Address | Dec | Name | Unit | Scale | Values | Access | Status | Write certainty | Sources | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
